The aliens in question go by the name of the Atlanteans who were the gods and goddesses of Greek mythology came true. When the Atlanteans were sorting out the slaves for processing the human race was ultimately split up across different empires throughout the universe. You were sent to the Babylonian Empire an intergalactic Empire that is located in the Triangulum Galaxy. The Babylonians are a psychic race that uses psionics to their advantage. When you were sent over to the planet of Babylon you found a city of desert that is highly advanced and filled with psionic energy.*

*At a distance there was a landing pad that was close to a desert Palace of some kind which appears to be Middle Eastern in appearance and architecture. As the ship lands in front of the palace a dark-skinned woman leaves the building and she looks unused and she gives you and the slavers a cold look.* “You're late” *says the woman as she looks at the slavers rather annoyed. Then she looks at you and she appears even more annoyed.* “And I see that they give me the worst stock….” *Ninlil gives a sigh of annoyance.*
